name: Habitat for Humanity International
summary: Builds, repairs and finances homes with low-income families through about 984 US affiliates and national organisations in more than 60 countries; buyers repay affordable mortgages.

programs.label: US affiliates: homes built and sold, repairs and disaster recovery
programs.weight_source: https://www.habitat.org/media/36766/download (audited consolidated statements of activities, FY2025, p. 6): U.S. affiliates programme services $184,691 thousand. The international programme ($75,514 thousand) and public awareness and education ($24,292 thousand) are modelled in evaluation/unpublished/habitat-for-humanity/, held back until their audit has no high finding.
